item.title: Lincoln, Washington portraits in schools gets Senate backing
item.description: The Senate voted 36-2 on Thursday to approve a proposal directing county school districts to display portraits of Presidents George Washington and Abraham Lincoln in every public school. The measure, SB 420, would require the Department of Education to select the portraits and distribute them to school districts. item.description: The Chipley High School (CHS) Debate Team earned top honors at the Florida Civics and Debate Initiative’s Northwest Qualifier #3, held February 7 in Pensacola. item.title: Senate passes bill creating public registry of animal abusers
item.description: People who abuse animals would be put on a public registry under a bill passed unanimously by the Florida Senate on Friday.
